summary: A law that is undone is told as the rule it replaced no longer applying, never as 'passed'.
realLife: The sampled council stories report an act the body took, an ordinance read for the last time or a notice dropped. The game's rule is that a law in force is kept or undone, never 'passed'.
sources: The Village Reporter (Wauseon, Ohio), council passes two ordinances on final reading: https://thevillagereporter.com/wauseon-city-council-council-passes-two-ordinances-on-final-reading/
Chanute Tribune (Kansas), city to remove certain legal publications from the Tribune: https://www.chanute.com/article/598,city-of-chanute-to-remove-certain-legal-publications-from-the-tribune
